description: Fix disk listing missing roots, path contract, write-path default volume resolution, and exact filename normalization. Storage owns configured default_volume selection; DiskBridge maps provider path input and tolerates full destination paths when basename exactly equals name; BO Disk settings expose a single default-volume toggle. Tests first: DiskBridge maps / and nested disk paths while preserving filters.parent, normalizes full file paths only for file creation, and preserves folders; Storage omits ENOENT roots, uses default_volume for unqualified write destinations, preserves explicit volume precedence and ACL filtering. Branches: root path, nested path, filters precedence, all-missing roots, mixed roots, unauthorized entries, non-ENOENT errors, default volume fallback, explicit volume precedence, filename exact match, folder non-normalization. Mocking: DiskBridge router stub only; Storage uses temporary filesystem. Docs: tool/schema docs only if behavior is clarified. Validation: focused tests, mix format, mix q.

comments.text: Implemented listing-only fix. DiskBridge now maps agent tool path '/' to root listing and rooted nested paths to Storage filters.parent, with explicit filters taking precedence; actor/config propagation is unchanged. Storage root enumeration now omits only ENOENT configured roots, keeps existing roots subject to the existing can_read_entry? ACL filter, and returns structured volume_unavailable errors for non-directories and other stat failures. Added unit/property regressions for root/nested path normalization, precedence, all-missing and mixed roots, ACL filtering, malformed roots, and generic stat errors. Validation: 62 focused tests (including 2 properties) pass; 145 adjacent tool/Channels tests pass; mix q passes. No docs change because this restores the documented list_documents path behavior. Work remains uncommitted per session policy, so issue stays in_progress until landing.

Corrected root-path semantics after live tool verification. DiskBridge now preserves normalized path:'/' instead of erasing it. Storage distinguishes explicit '/' from internal no-path listing: '/' aggregates immediate entries from every existing configured volume, skips missing and empty roots without terminating, applies the existing ACL filter after aggregation, and paginates the combined source-ordered entries with one root cursor. Internal no-path calls still return volume root folders; nested paths still map to filters.parent. Added regressions for populated+empty+missing volumes, non-recursive immediate depth, cross-volume ACL filtering, and cross-volume pagination. Validation: 210 focused/adjacent tests passed before final cleanup; final focused suite 65 tests including 2 properties passed; mix q and git diff --check pass. Changes remain uncommitted.

Fixed the remaining live-call authorization issue. Root enumeration was correct (scanned counts raw immediate entries), but Executor's trusted tool_context skip_permissions flag was dropped by DataSourceTool. DataSourceTool now copies only context skip_permissions:true into Channels event opts. Channels.Api stamps that trusted flag onto disk's internal event actor, overriding any caller-supplied __event_actor marker; DiskBridge and Storage.Api then use their existing actor forwarding/bypass handling. Model request fields cannot enable bypass, false/missing context remains fail-closed, and actorless trusted machine contexts are supported. Validation: 170 focused tests including listing/search, boundary propagation, actor forwarding, Storage ACL, and anti-forgery cases pass; mix q, diagnostics, and git diff --check pass. Raw scanned statistics retained as requested. Changes remain uncommitted.
